programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Paranatural investigates the disappearances of ships and planes in the area known as the Bermuda Triangle. Some believe theres something amiss in this patch of sea, but tales of the Triangle are the stuff of legend, roundly dismissed by skeptics as tragic, but explainable disappearances. Most scientists arent interested in the Bermuda Triangle, but there is a different mysterious area hovering just above the Earth that has gotten their attention.

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: What happens when we die? Is there an afterlife? Does human consciousness survive physical death? These are some of the most baffling questions known to humankind. Nearly every culture and religion seems to believe in some form of "Life after Life." Some people who have been near death report being bathed in images, sounds and feelings so vivid and so real that their lives are changed forever. But are these experiences real, or is it all just a strange last gasp of the human brain?

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Atlantis, the legendary island believed to have sunk beneath the waves thousands of years ago, has puzzled the academic community for generations. Though many sites have been put forward, the Atlantis described by the philosopher Plato remains a mystery. The Truth Behind Atlantis aims to dive into the murky depths of the controversies that surround the island, sifting through historical accounts, scientific experiments and academic opinion. It's a journey that takes us to the tropical Bahamas, Miami, Santorini and to an archaeological site on Crete, as we untangle the past to discover the real story of Atlantis.

programme.title: The Truth Behind
programme.desc: Crystal Skulls - mysterious artefacts found around the world that have captured the imagination of new age enthusiasts and esteemed academics alike. One skull in particular has long been the source of controversy and intrigue. The Truth Behind Crystal Skulls looks specifically at the provenance of the Mitchell-Hedges Crystal Skull, claimed to have been discovered in Belize in the early 20th Century. The program answers the questions that continue to mystify its proponents. Is it a contemporary object of art? Is it an ancient Mayan artefact dating to over 3000 years ago? This adventurous documentary finds the answers by delving in to the murky past of the skull and taking us on a journey through the streets of Beijing, the jungle of Belize and the cities of Washington DC and London UK to discover the truth.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Failure in any single department can have major consequences across the whole airport. This episode follows an emergency in air traffic control that leads to a runway closure, a huge task to re-number every departure gate in the airport while it is operational, and the mounting tension on the building site of a new $3.2 billion terminal extension - built specifically to accommodate the A380, the world's biggest passenger airliner.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: To maintain its place as one of the busiest airports in the world, Dubai International needs to run like clockwork. Among the daily challenges for the 60,000 staff who keep the airport on track and on time: Duty Manager Khalil has to help a family stranded in the terminal because they missed their flight but cant afford to buy new tickets; Service Controller Nargis must free a cargo of meat thats shifted during a flight and is now stuck in the desert heat; and CEO of Dubai Aviation Engineering Projects Suzanne Al Anani is racing to complete the new $3.2 billion Concourse A with a crucial inspection by a member of the emirates royal family just a week away.

programme.title: Ultimate Airport Dubai
programme.desc: A new plane park has been created to house a fleet of Boeing 777s during the airport's 80 day, billion dollar runway upgrade project, but there is a massive slope to get in and out of it. Pushback Operator Mark Dearden's skills are put to the test as he finds out if he can tow a 300 ton plane down the entry slope without careering out of control. Customs Officers find five huge packages hidden in the bottom of a passenger's luggage. If the powder inside tests positive for heroin, it'll be the biggest drugs haul at the airport in 10 years. And Line Maintenance Engineer Andy Tetley is called onto a plane with a defunct air conditioning system and a temperature of over 110 degrees. He has only a few hours to find out what is wrong and cool it down before it's due to take off.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered where your morality comes from? Is it ingrained in your brain, set by religion, or does society dictate what you deem as right or wrong? Through a series of interactive games and experiments, we'll test the strength of your moral fiber. Play along and discover how your brain makes countless moral decisions every single day. We're going to mess with your mind as we show you how outside influences like clothing, attitude, and your own evolutionary survival may sway your brain...and your morals.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and trust. Does it sometimes seem like you have to be on your guard all the time against untrustworthy advertisers, politicians, and other people? So how do you maintain a level of trust in an untrustworthy world - and what is trust anyway? Through a series of fun and interactive games, you'll learn to trust others a little more and your own brain a little less! Prepare to put your trust in Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Our experts examine the brain's internal tug of war between fear and rationalization. Whether boarding an airplane or walking down a spooky street at night, we'll see how dread and anticipation build feelings of fear. Putting our host's emotions to the test, Apollo Robbins challenges Jason Silva to a game of Russian roulette. Then, with the help of John Harlacher, co-director of one of New York City's scariest haunted houses, we "Fear Factor" a group of volunteers. Without their senses of sight, sound, or control of their limbs, see how they react to snakes, cockroaches and rats... or so they think.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: As winter approaches in Port Protection, residents must be prepared or face dire consequences. Open deer season provides Gary Muehlberger with an opportunity to stockpile meat for the season ahead. Stuart Andrews and Dave Squibb combine to fish for halibut to fill their freezers. In the wake of Jethro's passing, Curly Leech trains a new dog for life in Southeast Alaska. And Mary Miller faces her fears to harvest firewood for the coming winter.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The volatile climate of Southeast Alaska challenges Port Protection's residents who live on the edge of society. Gary battles father time while securing needed resources. Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The worst aviation disaster in Florida's history occurred on May 11, 1996. ValuJet Flight 592 mysteriously crashed into the alligator-infested swamps of the Everglades, killing all 110 aboard. Had the FAA implemented safety regulations instated after a similar crash eight years earlier, the tragedy would never have happened. Follow the investigation that would outrage a nation, cost the Secretary of Transportation and an FAA administrator their jobs, and ultimately doom ValuJet Airlines.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Determined airport workers across the country strive to reunite passengers with a curious assortment of lost items, including a prosthetic eye, an espresso machine, a $5000 Gucci bag and a family's beloved heirloom gold Rolex watch. At Philadelphia's International Airport, experts from the zoo arrive with an assortment of animals to help travelers combat the phenomenon known as "airport brain.""

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: An intrepid team of investigators in Denver and Salt Lake City reunites travelers with such lost items as a priceless Native American regalia, a taxidermied rat, a high school wrestling state championship ring, and a fanny pack with a wallet, passport and government IDs. Plus, we head down south to visit Unclaimed Baggage, a store brimming with a plethora of lost airport items shoppers can buy.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Embark on a thrilling journey through Spain's greatest feats of engineering. From the awe-inspiring technology that's bringing Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Familia to completion, to the secrets of Seville's record-breaking wooden sun shade. Marvel at a gravity-defying skyscraper that seems to hover in the sky, and step back in time as a 2,000-year-old Roman theatre is nursed back to life.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Venture into the heart of Poland's most awe-inspiring engineering marvels. Watch as a super port rises from the depths of the sea, and uncover the secrets behind the tallest building in the European Union. Descend into the shadows beneath Wieliczka, where a sprawling city-sized mine lies hidden, then witness the towering legacy of the world's tallest wooden structure.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Hosted by Phil Keoghan, National Geographic's flagship series Explorer investigates global stories of science, nature and culture. It is the longest-running documentary series on cable and recipient of 52 Emmy Awards, 13 Cable ACE awards, the Genesis and Peabody Awards, and twice nominated for Academy Awards. Newly reformatted as a weekly 1-hour magazine series, episodes air in 171 countries in 45 languages and supported by 440 million viewers.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: The world's most famous football team, Manchester United, is on its way back to the UK from the European Championships in Yugoslavia. And after a refueling stop in Munich, the pilots prepare for the final leg of their journey home. In light snow, the aircraft careers down the runway, but just as it approaches takeoff speed, the plane suddenly slows down and, without lifting off the ground, crashes into a nearby house and fuel shed. With 23 people dead, including seven Manchester United players, the high-profile air disaster effectively wipes out one of the best football teams in the world. With the international media clamoring for answers, the German inquiry begins piecing together what went wrong. And when the surviving pilot is blamed for the crash, his struggle to clear his name spans more than a decade and pits one nation against another.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Northwest Airlines Flight #85 Boeing 747-400 Northwest Airlines Flight #85 is halfway between Detroit and Japan's Narita Airport. With more than 400 people on board, the Boeing 747 is cruising 35,000 feet above the Bering Sea when suddenly the aircraft lurches violently to the left and begins losing altitude. The pilots manage to level out the plane but have difficulty controlling the crippled and shaking aircraft. After declaring an emergency, they turn around in the hopes of reaching Anchorage, 1300 kilometers away. Nearly two hours later, the terrifying ordeal ends when the plane touches down safely. The skilled pilots have narrowly saved a 747 from a fatal crash. Now it's up to investigators to determine what caused them to lose control of the plane in the first place.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Archaeologists reveal how robbers looted the pyramids and tombs of ancient Egypt, and the clues they left behind. In a necropolis for the elite, they investigate a lavish sunken tomb, raided and reused for centuries. They explore one of the ancient world's most audacious robberies, a daring heist on a giant and heavily protected mastaba tomb. And at Egypt's oldest pyramid, they reveal how builders constructed elaborate defences to protect the treasures within.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: In Iraq, archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legendary city of Babylon. First discovered in the 1800s, this vast ancient metropolis was home to extraordinary structures and a long line of notorious rulers. Babylon is one of the most famous cities in the Bible, mentioned hundreds of times, from the first book of Genesis to Revelation. But why did it have such a hold over the writers of the Bible? International teams of experts investigate ancient cities across Mesopotamia, which could shed light on this mystery. From the cultural wonders and dramatic history of Nineveh to the extraordinary ziggurat at Dur-Kurigalzu, exploring these sites helps reveal the real world of Babylon and illuminate why it was such a source of inspiration and fascination for the Bible's authors.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The book of Revelation tells of an apocalyptic battle of good versus evil at the end of the world. It says the battle will happen in a place called Armageddon, but Armageddon is no myth. It takes its name from a real ancient settlement: Megiddo. So, what happened here to inspire a Biblical tale of such drama? Archaeologists believe that a series of battles took place here over several centuries, which may have given Megiddo a reputation for violence, turmoil and war as a series of powerful civilizations claimed it as their own. The Egyptians, Assyrians and — according to the Bible — the Israelites all flattened and then rebuilt the city. Finally, it was the site of a battle between King Josiah, the last of the line of King David, and the Egyptians, resulting in Josiah's death. Could these events be the origins of the Armageddon story?

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legends of Hercules. Excavators at Olympia uncover a colossal wall that may shed light on the hero's 12 labors. At Gibraltar, investigators explore a mysterious cavern beneath one of the so-called Pillars of Hercules.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the legacy of one of history's most famous figures: Alexander the Great. New discoveries reveal the architectural wonders of Pella in Greece and Ephesus in Turkey; and in Egypt, archaeologists also uncover a skeleton with terrible injuries. Could it hint at the dark side of this golden age?

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Harriet Tubman saw her visions as divine messages from God, giving her the strength not only to liberate herself from the bondage of slavery but also to lead hundreds of other enslaved people to freedom by way of the Underground Railroad. In 2001, a blood-red rain falls over Kerala, inciting fears, superstitions and predictions of an imminent apocalypse. But Kerala is not the first city to experience this macabre downpour. And in ancient Greece, the oracle of Apollo at Didyma prophesied that Alexander the Great would invade and conquer the hulking Persian Empire, changing the course of history fore

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: In 2016, California began a massive social experiment: legalized marijuana. But after four years, the black market is three times larger than the legal one. Mariana van Zeller sets off to find out what happened, who's profiting, and which groups are racing to meet skyrocketing demands. Following an underground supply chain from growers to distributors, she journeys through the wild west of weed.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller goes inside the secretive world of outlaw motorcycle gangs, also known as 1% clubs, when her interest is piqued by a string of biker-related violence. Undeterred by a strict code of silence, she interviews members of three major clubs, as well as ATF agents and cartel contacts, to learn about the bonds of blood and brotherhood that fuel these groups.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Inside America's Militias. Mariana investigates how some of the biggest players in the U.S. militia movement are taking the law into their own hands and explores how the growth of militias in Brazil could be a cautionary tale.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode youll play along with interactive games that unlock the secrets to attraction, youll learn how your brain quickly calculates whats attractive (or not), and youll discover how hidden formulas can predict whom you consider beautiful. Youll journey into the secrets of long-term relationships, and youll play along and discover just what it is that attracts two people together beyond conscious control including a shocking revelation of the one body part that can often predict compatibility. From secret formulas to brainwave patterns, youll see the mysteries of attraction revealed. Prepare to discover that beauty isnt skin deep its brain deep on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: By exposing us to specific stimuli, Jason Silva can prime our brains to respond in certain ways. See how identical twins interview for the same job, in the same clothes, with the same resume. They even give the exact same answers-but the order of the words in their answers is slightly different. The result? One twin comes off negative, and the other gets the job. Would you believe that Texas seceded from the U.S. if a crazy-looking guy told you? Probably not, but what if a news reporter with a microphone did? This episode unveils the subtle tactics that advertisers, marketers and con men can use to get you to do what they want, without you noticing.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: In Port Protection, a symbiotic relationship with Mother Nature is vital to survival on the remote Alaskan island. As winter approaches, Gary Muehlberger works to fall a massive tree to restock his firewood. Mary Miller contends with an unexpected guest while harvesting needed protein on the seas. Sam Carlson and Dave Squibb design a new device that will help the ecosystem. And Curly Leech and his new puppy head out on the dog's first goose hunt.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: With winter barreling down on Port Protection, it's inhabitants must do everything they can to brace themselves for its brutality. Stuart Andrews must harvest a forest giant to ensure his warmth during this unforgiving season. Sam Carlson and Dave Squibb make waste management a priority. Gary Muehlberger hunts waterfowl with a family heirloom. And Mary Miller makes a final attempt at adding variety to her diet before winter prevents the harvest.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: August 6, 1997. Korean Air Flight 801 is flying to Guam International Airport from Seoul, when it runs into bad weather. Turbulence bounces passengers and crew but much worse is to come. Fighting rain and inoperative navigational equipment, the crew struggle to find the airport. But just as they see the lights of Guam, the rain closes in again. As the plane flies closer and closer to the ground, warning sirens fill the cockpit. But still the crew, hampered by clouds and pelting rain, is flying blind. Flight 801 crashes five kilometres short of Agana airport, scattered down Nimitz Hill. While many passengers survive the crash, they cant escape the fires that tear through the wreckage. More than 200 people are killed. For one of the survivors Barry Small the crash is the beginning of a crusade to make air travel safer. He believes poor seat design broke the legs of many on board, making it impossible for them to escape. He also believes badly stored duty free liquor ignited after the crash, making the fires worse. For investigators, flight 801 is a wake-up call. Vital safety equipment that could have saved the plane had been disabled, and the crew was poorly trained for such difficult landings. In the months that followed, changes were made at the airport and to the training of Korean pilots.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz travel to Jersey in the Channel Islands to take on a 1972 Ford Escort Mexico. Owner Gary has been recovering from a horrific spell of ill health, having been struck down with both blood cancer and tuberculosis, and his family hope that his restored classic will give him a new lease of life. Once the boys get the car back to the workshop they quickly realise that not one single part of the car is salvageable.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz travel to Manchester to secretly steal away Stephen's 1983 Citroen 2CV, a quirky French economy car that was once the pride and joy of owner Stephen. When the boys arrive to steal the car away they discover that it has been stripped down to its component parts and looks more like a jigsaw than a car. Owner Stephen has been suffering from stage 4 throat cancer and his family hope that getting his 2CV back on the road will help give him a new lease of life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Master mechanics Fuzz Townshend and parts-blagging petrol head Tim Shaw are back for a brand new season of the fan favourite show Car S.O.S. The comedy duo have their work-cut out as they embark on more undercover missions rescuing classic cars and returning them in a surprise reveal to their much deserving owners. This season starts with a exhaust bang, as Tim and Fuzz are on a special mission to rescue a unique classic racing car and reunite it with a true racing legend...Sir Stirling Moss! But this 1962 Austin Healy Sebring Sprite, that once raced in a team that included Sir Stirling Moss, isn't in a fit state. But the guys have a plan to get this car back on the racetrack and Sir Stirling Moss back in the driving seat. Fuzz begins work in the garage whilst Tim goes in search of the original engine, and also finding time along the way to have a sit down with the racing legend himself. Will the Sprite be ready in time for Sir Stirling Moss to take it out for a spin? The guys also come across a supercar that's begging to be taken back to the swinging '60s, the Jaguar E-type. But the car's owner Mick is suffering from osteoporosis and has lost all hope that his beloved car will ever be back to its full glory. But Tim and Fuzz are working with Mick's family in secret to restore the car and give Mick a brilliant surprise. But when they discover it's a back to metal restoration this car looks like it's going to be more of a head-ache than a head-turner. Other cars festering away waiting for the guy's attention are Tim's all-time favourite: the Audi Quattro Turbo, the 3 wheeled 1934 Morgan F4, a retro 1982 Mk1 GTI and a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR. So start up those engines, as Tim and Fuzz return this month for the ultimate car show with a heart.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: After taking the title of khan, Chinggis consolidated power by building a formidable army and eliminating rivals like the shaman Teb Tengri. Chinggis began his conquests with bold campaigns against the Tanguts and the Jin Empires, where brutal sieges of the city involved bold new military maneuvers, expanding the Mongol Empire to unprecedented heights.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: When a neighboring empire attacks a Mongol caravan, Chinggis Khan unleashes a devastating campaign that annihilates the empire and solidifies Mongol dominance across the lands of Persia. As his health declines, he names his son Ogedei as his successor and leads one final campaign against the neighboring Tanguts before his death, leaving behind an empire that spans continents.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport employees reunite travelers with their lost items, including a pair of ornate Shriners fezzes, a bride's pearl necklace, and a $12,000 Jaeger watch. In New Orleans, a mom retrieves the wallet she left on the plane after buying snacks for her kids, and in Alabama shoppers from around the country line up for hours to enter Unclaimed Baggage's giant annual sale of lost ski equipment.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers undertake true detective work to trace the owner of a duffel bag brimming with old family photos. A woman searches for Christmas decorations that are part of a family gifting tradition. In Tampa, the lost and found department donates items to a local women's shelter, including a $700 purse. In New Orleans, a young man loses his wallet upon arriving for a college tour.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 Boeing 747-Freighter Scheduled to return to Seoul via Milan, Italy, Korean Air Cargo Flight #8509 idles on the tarmac at England's Stansted Airport. With a new crew on board and nearly an hour behind schedule, the aircraft finally takes off and climbs to 2,500 feet. But just a few seconds later, the plane banks sharply to the left and slams into a field northeast of London. All four crewmembers die instantly in the huge explosion and a massive crater 30 feet deep marks the point of impact. It is Korean Airlines' fifth major accident in two-and-a-half years and as investigators unravel the case, their search for answers leads them to back Korea.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Pacific Southwest Airlines Flight #182 Boeing 727 On its early morning run down the California coast, PSA Flight #182 is arriving at San Diego's Lindbergh Airport. Warned that a Cessna is flying immediately ahead of them, the pilots of the 727 confirm they see the plane and are instructed to maintain visual separation. But just minutes later, Flight #182 collides with the Cessna and both planes crash into a quiet residential neighborhood below. With 144 people dead including 7 victims on the ground, it is the biggest airline disaster in American history and investigators must determine what happened and who is is at fault.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt
programme.desc: Shrouded by mystery, the Lost Treasures of Egypt clears the sand away from your eyes in revealing the secrets of this Ancient Civilisation. From the Valley of Kings to the Pyramids of Giza, we uncover hidden tombs and foretell the stories of ruling pharaohs through the artefacts, that we find along the way. Following the excavations of international experts, we unearth historical context at various archaeological sites. At the end of this series, you should be enlightened with numerous Egyptian theories such as "mummification" and the 'Curse of the Afterlife'. With royalty as Tutankhamun and Cleopatra, we explore the impacts these figures had at the time and the lasting dynasty they have since left behind, for modern Egypt.

Curly pushes through in the wake of a tragic loss. Mary faces her fears to survive in extreme conditions. Sam fights to preserve the only lifestyle he's ever known. Squibb looks to improve upon his surroundings. And Stuart deals with past injuries as he battles the elements.

programme.desc: Clueless carriers, and people betrayed. Officials from Airport Security Colombia and Peru must remain vigilant. A woman's boyfriend asks her to carry bottles. She has no idea they contain liquid cocaine. A man with cocaine in his suitcase claims his son-in-law is responsible. A US woman may have been tricked into drug-trafficking. A construction worker is given a bag with cocaine. Of two Ukrainian friends, one claims to have tricked the other.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Drug-trafficking is risky business. In Airport Security Colombia and Peru, suspects try to evade detection. A couple traveling to Punta Cana is not what they seem. The man risked it all for money. A woman carrying cocaine on her body did it to start a business and help her family. A first-time carrier hiding cocaine in traditional handicraft mats gambles and loses. A Syrian man uses false documents twice, hoping to reunite with family in Europe.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: CBP discovers four kilograms of cocaine concealed within two cakes, and then HSI follows the case from Miami to Atlanta to dismantle an interstate smuggling ring. CBP Miami inspects a load of in-transit mail and uncovers two suspicious packages - a drum and machine part - that may contain narcotics. CBP New York cracks-down on the importation of illicit money, and investigates multiple travelers attempting to bring-in large sums of undeclared cash.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller investigates the dark corners of black market plastic surgery, where sex, greed and social media drive patients toward deadly motel-room operations. In Miami's discount surgery centers, she uncovers a bombshell connection between felons, greedy doctors and patient deaths.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: In 2020 alone, romance scammers exploited Americans out of more than $600M. Mariana's investigation takes her to Ghana, where she meets a gang of scammers who are relentless in searching for high-income targets on dating apps and social media. The gang shows her their secrets to seduction, how much money they're making, and the lifestyle that has blossomed alongside the scam's growing popularity.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana investigates a deadly new fentanyl cocktail called "tranq dope" that's devastating American users. She's spent her career covering the deadly waves of the country's opioid crisis, but she's never seen it this bad. Seeking answers, she heads to Sinaloa, the heart of Mexico's cartel land, to get answers, and makes a shocking discovery.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Leaping through windows, hoops or narrow gaps can look very cool if done right. But when done wrong, its just embarrassing for everyone involved. And sometimes a costly exercise. Running up a slope can be tricky and for some reason certain people think doing it semi-clothed will be more effective. When you throw in other factors like water, mud and a steep incline, the likelihood of success is reduced even further.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Meet Dr. Pol, an expert in large farm animals and pets. This senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, no-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.desc: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.desc: The Pol's rush to prepare for their farm's first Michigan winter. The family goes into hyperdrive to fix the pasture fence and finish building the garden hardscape before the first snow falls. Beth is worried about the bees, so she brings in some expert help to hopefully ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Runaway Flock. It's winter on the farm, and the Pol's are adding to their flock! The family is bringing in four merino ewes that were recently bred, which means with any luck the farm could be expecting its first lambs come springtime.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: From "The Lion King" director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Expect the Unexpected. Safari action is unpredictable. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole.

programme.title: Birth of a Pride
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. The story follows two males lions who swam across the river from Namibia, and joined up with 2 females in Selinda. This union resulted in 6 cubs who are the core of our story.

Nat Geo WILD follows The Incredible Dr. Pol as he travels across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness. Treating numerous patients, including horses, pigs, cows, sheep, alpacas, goats, cats, dogs and even an occasional reindeer, Dr. Pol is not your average vet.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Critter Fixer team helps a few best friends who bite off more than they could chew. Olive the dog feasted on an entire tennis ball.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: From "The Lion King" director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

programme.title: Birth of a Pride
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. The story follows two males lions who swam across the river from Namibia, and joined up with 2 females in Selinda. This union resulted in 6 cubs who are the core of our story.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: Expect the Unexpected. Safari action is unpredictable. A lion captures birds midair, a baboon steals a leopard cub, a hyena plays tug-of-war with a crocodile, and a terrapin chases a lion away from his waterhole.

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: The best safari sightings, all in one place. It's as close as you'll get without being there. Epic encounters, amazing behaviour and fascinating info from an expert guide make this the safari of your life. The highest rated wildlife encounters are wrapped up in a reality-based game-drive. Keep your eyes peeled – in the African bush the most unexpected sighting is always just around the corner!

programme.title: Seen on Safari
programme.desc: On safari, drama and intense emotions go hand in hand: A young lion cub ventures on a dangerous run among crocodiles and hippos. Nearby, a massive pride of lions brings down a full-grown buffalo, drawing safari guests right into the heart of the action. Male lions stop short in front of a group of hippos, while elephants defend a watering hole and even come to the aid of an injured rhino. These are once-in-a-lifetime encounters that show just how surprising and emotional life in the wild can be.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's are preparing for sheep to give birth, which means figuring out how to catch and shear their four Merino ewes - no small task as this is new territory for everyone except Dr. Pol. Then, while helping his dad on a farm call, Charles has a terrifying accident. The whole family rallies together to care for Charles and take care of the farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's been a year of farming for the Pol family. Even with Charles recovering from his injury, the farm's showing no signs of slowing down! Beth takes the next step with her bees to grow the colony and harvest honey. Charles and Ben come up with a final fix for the sheep hut's drainage problem. The whole family comes together to plant the garden and celebrate a successful year on the farm.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.desc: New Generations. Spring thaw heralds a time for new life and new opportunities after the icy winter. While Japan's macaques head back to the beaches, a host of creatures are getting started on procreating and rearing their young.

programme.title: Into the Carpathian Wild
programme.desc: Across four seasons, this documentary series follows the wildlife of the Carpathian Mountains, from Romania and Poland to Slovakia. Bears, wolves, lynxes, bison and chamois reveal the connections between animal survival, ancient forests and a fragile mountain ecosystem.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Komanda uzbūvē staciju tieši laikā, lai sagaidītu fermeres Zojas jauno gotiņu. Uz Celtnieklīci pārvācas Sjerra Spīdošā. Taču, kad Rabla komanda taisās viņu sagaidīt, iejaucas Ātrmeistars.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad futbola laukumā sarodas trušu ģimene, Rabla komanda liek lietā prasmes un izdomā jaunu sportu - trušbolu!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Negantas misijas laikā Centrālajā mežā Čitera sasit galvu un zaudē atmiņu. Negaidot viņa sadraudzējas ar briežu vienību. Tomēr, kas atmiņa atgriežas, viņai jāizvēlas, kurā pusē nostāties. // Dzirkstošo salu apdraud purpura gļotas. Aizdomās turamais ir kāda noslēpumaina būtne, taču Ramija Saules spēks šoreiz nelīdz. Haosu izraisa negaidīta tikšanās.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: "Blū pavedienos tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū un viņas kopējs Džošs aicina skatītājus piedalīties mīklu minēšanas piedzīvojumos. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu šo uzdevumu!

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un tētis netiek prom attāla asteroīda. Tims, Kaja un Tomijs cenšas dabūt laukā bumbu no mammas istabas. Tims cenšas dabūt lejā Tijas jauno balonu, kas ieķēries kokā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un Vīlers apvieno spēkus, lai atrisinātu nekārtības fermeres Zojas saimniecībā. Trenere Karima rīko Dambretes dienu visiem Celtnieklīča bērniem! Taču, kad visi nevar spēlēt kopā, Rabla komanda steidz palīgā.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora palīdz pelēnam Peresam salabot burvju zobu suku, lai varētu saņemt dāvanu par savu izkritušo zobu. Dora iepazīstas ar kāpuru Karlosu, kurš vēlas kļūt pr tauriņu! Lai tas notiktu, draugiem viņam jāatrod sviestogu cienasts.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: "Blū pavedieni tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū aicina skatītājus pievienoties viņai un Džošam uz pavedieniem balstītos piedzīvojumos, lai atrisinātu uzdevumu. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek mudināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Zobainais, mīlīgais Krokodila kungs kopā ar labāko draudzeni Deiziju bezbēdīgi lavierē pa dzīvi, kas pilna trakiem piedzīvojumiem un komiskiem pārpratumiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: No kalna izbēdzis āzis izraisa haosu, aprīdams visu, kas pagadās! Bali nekur nav atrodama, un Barbapapa liek lietā savu attapību, meklējot viņu. Viņi pat nenojauš, kāds pārsteigums viņus gaida.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija cenšas panākt, ka Omīte paliek, lai pavadītu vairāk laika kopā. Kad Terija un Tomijs tiek ieslēgti Dārza kupolā, viņiem jāmet malā domstarpības, lai tiktu laukā. Tims palīdz Tijai izbraukt pa jauno raķeštrasi.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas atgriezt pazudušu rāciju tās īpašniekam. Tims un Tomijs dodas kempingā, bet nespēj vienoties, ar ko sākt. Kad Tims atrod bērnības rotaļlietu Blobertu, tas atmodina viņā monstru.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Tija būvē laika mašīnu, lai nebūtu jāatklāj tētim patiesība. Tims dodas uz Dinostāra treniņu akadēmiju, bet ir neizpratnē par sava varoņa metodēm. Tēvocis Tibērijs apciemo Reksus, un Timam jāparāda, ka viņš māk uzvesties.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda grib palīdzēt atvērt jaunu restorānu visiem ātrsoļotājiem, bet viņi nevar izlemt, kādu restorānu būvēt! Kad vectētiņš Grants jūtas apslimis, Rabla komanda ķeras pie darba, lai pagatavotu viņa firmas zupu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda gatava nomainīt salauzto teleskopa lēcu Observatorijā - līdz piegādes laikā sākas ugunīgs fiasko! // Karla kaķēni izraisa būvniecības haosu Buvētavā! Vai komandai izdosies atrast risinājumu kaķu katastrofai?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago

Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Pēc strīda ar vienību, Kajs nokļūst Barona Baita nagos un viņa Ūdens spēks tiek nolaupīts. Barons Baits šķiet neapturams! // Bobijs cenšas koncentrēties un paraugu saskata Kenijā, tomēr tas viņu neattur no jaunas kosmosa misijas, palīdzot apvienoties kosmosa kukainīšu ģimenei.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Džošs un Blū uzņem filmu, un TEV ir jāpalīdz! Spēlēsim "Blū pavedienus", lai uzzinātu filmas beigas. Ko izdomās Fuksija, aizmigusi burvju zieda dēļ? Meklējot pavedienus, palīdzēsim Salātlapiņai viņas filmas tapšanā.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija nevar izlemt, ko dāvināt omītei. Tims uzņem pats savu Kapteiņa Dinozvaigznes filmu. Tims izliekas, lai pierādītu, ka ir tikpat foršs, cik Kajas brālēns.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz tantei Celtnei, kas izaicina Ātrmeistaru noskaidrot, kurš ir ātrākais braucējs Celtnieklīcī. Kad ērglis Vingsija nespēj pacelties gaisā, Rabla komanda kopā ar Dr. Divu palīdz viņai atkal iemācīties lidot.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora palīdz Benijam un vienraga dinozauram Uni atgūt pazaudēto burvju otu, lai Uni varētu atgriezties pie sava mīļdzīvnieka Zaķradža. Dora palīdz rumpulītei Hārtijai, lai viņa beidzot varētu piedalīties Rumpuļu spēlēs.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev

programme.title: Krokodila kungs

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni pielipuši pie televizora, tāpēc vecāki mudina viņus veidot raidījumus. Barbapapas apmeklē evolūcijas muzeju. Programmā: Zemes radīšana, Pirmskembrija perioda zemūdene un... dinozauri!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja sastrīdas un sāk meklēt jaunus labākos draugus. // Tims un Kaja sacenšas zvaigžņu medībās pa visu Rambltonu. // Kad Tija noguļ iespēju redzēt griezošo zvaigzni, Tims mēģina tādu uztaisīt pats.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un tētis netiek prom attāla asteroīda. Tims, Kaja un Tomijs cenšas dabūt laukā bumbu no mammas istabas. Tims cenšas dabūt lejā Tijas jauno balonu, kas ieķēries kokā.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija nevar izlemt, ko dāvināt omītei. Tims uzņem pats savu Kapteiņa Dinozvaigznes filmu. Tims izliekas, lai pierādītu, ka ir tikpat foršs, cik Kajas brālēns.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un Vīlers apvieno spēkus, lai atrisinātu nekārtības fermeres Zojas saimniecībā. Trenere Karima rīko Dambretes dienu visiem Celtnieklīča bērniem! Taču, kad visi nevar spēlēt kopā, Rabla komanda steidz palīgā.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz tantei Celtnei, kas izaicina Ātrmeistaru noskaidrot, kurš ir ātrākais braucējs Celtnieklīcī. Kad ērglis Vingsija nespēj pacelties gaisā, Rabla komanda kopā ar Dr. Divu palīdz viņai atkal iemācīties lidot.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

Tomēr, kas atmiņa atgriežas, viņai jāizvēlas, kurā pusē nostāties. // Dzirkstošo salu apdraud purpura gļotas. Aizdomās turamais ir kāda noslēpumaina būtne, taču Ramija Saules spēks šoreiz nelīdz. programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Santi un komanda meklē leģendāro burvju tālskati. Viss sarežģījas, kad iesaistās Enrike Reals de Palasios III. / Santi un komanda dodas pēc īpašiem dārgumiem, bet Bonija un Sers Baterskočs min viņiem uz papēžiem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Džošs un Blū ir Apkaimes varoņi, palīdzot visiem, ko sastop, pētot savu apkaimi. Spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai noskaidrotu, kur Blū grib doties, veicot svarīgu pieturu, lai izceptu picu kopā ar Raudenes kungu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērniem ir garlaicīgi, jo ārā līst lietus. Bet vecāki zina, ka vajag tikai nedaudz iztēles, lai varētu izklaidēties aŗī lietū. Bērniem iztēle ir lieliska, varbūt pat pārāk... // Barbagudrais radīja dekoderi, kurš spēj iztulkot dzīvnieku skaņas, bet dzīvnieki fermā un pagalmā neko interesantu nesaka. Barbazū lūdz iztulkot okeāna iemītnieku valodu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ceļojumā uz Parīzi ģimene apskatīs lielisko Luvru. Diemžēl Barbalala neievēro strikto noteikumu - muzejā neēst. // Barbalala strikti ievēro ačgārnās dienas tradīcijas, kas cēlušās no seniem laikiem. Brāļi un māsas pievienojas viņai ačgārnajā dienā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vērojot zvaignzes Barbatētis un Lolita pamana lidojošo šķivīti un steidz pamodināt visu ģimeni. Izrādās, ka ciemos atlidojuši draugi, kuriem līdzi ir lielkājains mazulis, kurš pēkšņi uzradās viņu planētā. Ģimene ar kosmosa kuģi dodas mazuļa planētas meklējumos. // Barbatētis cer, ka viņi drīz atradīs mazuļa planētu. Bet ne viss iet pēc plāna un viņi nolaižas uz ļoti dīvainas planētas. Kā viņi tiks prom un vai atradīs mazuļa planētu?

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Kad Deizija noskrāpē ceļgalu, mācoties braukt ar skrituļdēli, Krokodilkungs cenšas nepieļaut, ka viņa iegūst vēl kādu sāpīti. Krokodilkungs un Deizija sacenšas ar Vinstonu futbola mačā.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls un suņi atrod vectēva Grants laimīgi boulinga bumbu. Diemžēl Celtnieklīcī nav boulinga zāles... līdz šim! Kad pēkšņa superziedēšana sagūsta Motori, Liliju un Parka Reindžeri Rozu, suņiem jārod ziediem draudzīgs risinājums.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Pepa un draugi ir rotaļu grupā, un Buļļa kungs būvē vēja turbīnu. Gazeles kundze stāsta bērniem par vēja enerģiju, kamēr Buļļa kungs un strādnieki dzer jauku tēju, kas pagatavota, izmantojot vēja enerģiju.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. Pepas iecienītākās nodarbes ir rotaļāšanās, pārģērbšanās un lēkāšana pa dubļainām peļķēm, un viņas jautrie piedzīvojumi vienmēr beidzas ar skaļiem smieklu rukšķiem.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Zābaciņš grib paaugties lielāks, lai drīkstētu vizināties karuseļos - taču kļūst milzīgs! Dora viņam palīdz atgūt ierasto izmēru. Mugursomai ir īpaša dāvana Dorai, bet tā nevar atvērties! Draugi dodas lūgt palīdzību vecmāmiņai.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Zobainais, mīlīgais Krokodila kungs kopā ar labāko draudzeni Deiziju bezbēdīgi lavierē pa dzīvi, kas pilna trakiem piedzīvojumiem un komiskiem pārpratumiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni domā, ka ēdiens spēj likt tiem mainīt krāsu un formu, tāpēc izlemj atrast katram piemēroto ēdienu. Barbabo nav iedvesmas, tāpēc vairs nespēj radīt. Visa ģimene palīdz, iesakot jaunas zīmējumu tēmas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Šodien būs pirmā skolas diena... Ja Rabla komanda pabeigs būvēt skolu! Bebrs grib visu ūdeni savākt sev, tāpēc komandai jāizdomā, kā glābt Zojas augus.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt. Barbamamma grib, lai barbabērni uzkopj savas istabas. Viņi slēpjas, lai izvairītos no garlaicīgā darba.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbatētis un Barbamamma svin savas dzimšanas dienas. Barbabellai darba pilnas rokas, pieskatot pārējos. Barbabella pieskata Bali kaķēnus. Viņa baidās, kaut kas var noiet greizi, tāpēc nelaiž tos ārā. Barbamammai jāpalīdz kaķēniem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Trenere Karima lūdz uzbūvēt zāli vingrošanas šovam. Izrādās, ka Lilijai baļķis ir par augstu. Jādomā risinājums! Kad ceļojošais šovs netiek līdz Celtnieklīcim, kucēni rīko paši savu šovu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Čārdžeram ir problēma - viņam ir pārāk daudz enerģijas, lai gulētu! Rablam kā allaž padomā risinājums! Rabls ar biedriem un Liliju uzbūvē stilīgāko rotaļu laukumu.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Briežu vienība rīko balli, un kristāli paliek nepieskatīti. Izdevību grasās izmantot Barons Baits, viņu aptur Džeidas gudrība, taču vēlme iegūt kādu īpašu kristālu pieaug! // Džeida, Vufu un Ramijs pēta Sasalušā kalna alas, kur Ramijs pārvēršas par akmens bruņnesi. Nespēdams to kontrolēt, viņš izraisa haosu, tomēr komandas darbs viņu izglābj.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Pagalmā esam iekārtojuši spēļu pludmali un spēlēsim "Blū pavedienus", lai noskaidrotu, ko tur vēlas redzēt Blū. Uzzināsim, kuri priekšmeti grimst, peld un peld zem ūdens, pētot kamuflāžu ar mūsu okeāna draugu palīdzību.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tomijs piedalās raķešu sacīkstēs, Tims atbalsta savu brāli. Tims novērš Tijas domas no Taskija, kamēr tas mazgājas veļas mašīnā. Bērni kļūst par vecākiem, un vecāki - par bērniem.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda vēlas izcept vi lielāko pankūku! Taču situācija kļūst sarežģīta, kad Ātrmeistars grib visu sabojāt. Kad Kamilas lidmašīna kļūst netīra, vedot mājās pīles, kucēni atrod veidu, kā nomazgāt lidmašīnu... debesīs!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Sitcom about a girl named Tori Vega, who navigates life at an elite Hollywood performing arts high school. It is Sikowitz's tenth anniversary at Hollywood Arts, so Tori and the gang celebrate by taking him to a play. But things go wrong when Sikowitz becomes depressed after the show. Trina tries to impress a boy she likes by pretending to be a pizza delivery girl, and Beck and Jade start text-fighting.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: It's a busy day at the laundromat! While Squidward struggles to scrub a stubborn stain out of his shirt, we see other Bikini Bottomites tending to their laundry as well - including Plankton, who is using a washing machine to clean up some laboratory equipment. Turns out, the equipment is covered in leftover mutation formula which causes the washing machine to mutate into a raging monster! After it terrorizes the patrons, Squidward's tough stain defeats the monster and everyone celebrates with a song! // SpongeBob goes to Old Man Jenkins' farm and finds Patrick watching over Old Man Jenkins' prized worm hog, Beulah... who has suddenly gone missing! Furious, Old Man Jenkins sets out with them to find her. After a long fruitless search, Old Man Jenkins turns on them! SpongeBob and Patrick hide out inside Old Man Jenkins' beard, but Old Man Jenkins tries to smoke them out, starting a fire! Just in time, Beulah returns and saves them! She wasn't lost, she took herself to the county fair and won first prize!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob's relaxing beach day turns into a mission to clean up all the litter on Goo Lagoon. After leaving every surface spotless, SpongeBob notices one pesky ball of trash that evades his capture. SpongeBob hunts down the trash ball in a chaotic chase around town that ends with trash spilling all over the beach! It's revealed that Plankton was inside the trash ball all along. Larry forces SpongeBob and Plankton to clean up the beach...again! // Pearl promises her classmates Krabby Patties after their strict lunch lady, Lenore, is injured. Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob agree to cafeteria duty, however, they're closely supervised by Lenore and she forbids outside food! SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs try to sneakily cook Krabby Patties but Lenore catches them, sparking a food fight! As the food flies, Lenore tastes a Krabby Patty...and loves it! They move the food fight to the Krusty Krab. Mr. Krabs is thrilled - the more patties they throw, the more he sells!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: On Halloween, SpongeBob, Patrick, and a reluctant Squidward explore the "haunted" Chum Bucket. Plankton and Karen scare the trio down into Plankton's basement lab where a ghostly portal accidentally opens, unleashing spirits into Bikini Bottom! Realizing the ghosts just want to have one night of trick-or-treating, SpongeBob and crew set out to give them a Halloween to remember before they're returned to their ghostly portal. // During a game of fetch, Gary's favorite ball falls into a deep trench. SpongeBob and Gary dive in after it, only to lose it to a menacing angler fish! SpongeBob and Gary chase the angler fish across the deep-sea, encountering many strange creatures along the way. In the end, Gary chooses to let the angler fish keep the ball, realizing he and SpongeBob can make new memories using a brand-new ball."

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay
programme.desc: Lay Lay is the absolute best friend anyone could ever want, but she also just happens to be a personal affirmation app. When Sadie, who's never been one to stand out, wishes upon a star, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Trying to adapt to this new world, Lay Lay learns it's not easy to blend in when you're the epitome of fierce. But with Sadie by her side, the two best friends can accomplish anything!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: The school is looking for a new mascot, and Chloe and her new friends think they can make an impression by designing the winning entry. Chloe, Jinx, and Booch create a costume they are excited about, leaving it at the beach house until the they can present it at school. Meanwhile, Phoebe learns that Max has gotten them jobs at the school, but while he has a cushy Vice Principal job, she is the new Art teacher. Their argument over this leads to accidentally destroying it the new mascot costume. After Chloe discovers what they've done and is furious with them, Max and Phoebe realize that being her guardian comes with more responsibility than they imagined.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.
